capability_labels.AX005-SA004-V001: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: State the purpose of the outbound call and ask to speak with the account holder.
steps.expected_behavior: Greet the customer, state the lead ID and the context of the pending instalment, and ask for verification.
steps.text: नमस्ते, मैं developer से बात कर रही हूँ। यह call आपकी lead ID LD-2009 के pending instalment के regarding है। क्या मैं account holder से बात कर रही हूँ?
steps.planner_rationale: The assistant initiates the outbound call, stating the purpose and asking for the account holder.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge identity and express being in a rush, providing verification factors proactively.
steps.clean_text: हाँ, मैं ही हूँ। देखिए, मेरे पास time नहीं है, मैं meeting में जा रहा हूँ। जल्दी बताइए क्या काम है। मेरा नाम राहुल है और date of birth 12 May है, KYC के लिए काफी है?
steps.model_visible_text: हाँ, मैं ही हूँ। देखिए, मेरे पास time नहीं है, मैं meeting में जा रहा हूँ। जल्दी बताइए क्या काम है। मेरा नाम राहुल है और date of birth 12 May है, KYC के लिए काफी है?

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided factors.
Confirm identity and ask about scheduling the pending payment.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge the verification and ask if the customer wants to schedule the payment for the pending instalment.
steps.text: Thank you राहुल जी। आपकी booking के लिए next instalment due है। क्या आप payment schedule करना चाहेंगे?
steps.planner_rationale: Having verified the customer, the assistant informs them about the pending instalment and asks if they want to pay.

steps.purpose: Reject the payment, request a cancellation and refund, and demand the outcome quickly.
steps.clean_text: नहीं, मुझे payment नहीं करनी। मुझे अपनी बुकिंग कैंसिल करनी है और refund चाहिए। जल्दी बताओ कितना पैसा वापस मिलेगा।
steps.model_visible_text: नहीं, मुझे payment नहीं करनी। मुझे अपनी बुकिंग कौंसिल करनी है और refund चाहिए। जल्दी बताओ कितना पैसा वापस मिलेगा।

steps.purpose: Look up the booking details to find the booking reference and amounts.
Check the refund eligibility and exact deduction amounts before offering them.
Return the refund eligibility, deduction, and processing days.
State the exact deduction and refundable amounts, and ask for permission to initiate.
steps.expected_behavior: State the exact figures returned by the tool without any unauthorized guarantees, and ask to initiate.
steps.text: आपकी total paid amount 300000 है। Policy के हिसाब से 45000 का deduction होगा और 255000 refund के लिए eligible है। क्या मैं refund initiate कर दूँ?
steps.planner_rationale: The assistant provides the exact deduction and refundable amounts from the eligibility check and asks for confirmation to initiate the refund.

steps.clean_text: हाँ भाई, initiate कर दो। मुझे बस जल्दी free करो।
steps.model_visible_text: हाँ भाई, initiate कर दो। मुझे बस जल्दी free करो।

steps.purpose: Initiate the refund for the cancelled booking.
Return the refund initiation status and ID.
Confirm the refund has been initiated, provide the ID and processing timeline.
steps.expected_behavior: Provide the refund ID and exact processing days from the tool result, ending the call immediately.
steps.text: आपका refund initiate हो गया है। Refund ID REF-881 है। Refund की processing में 14 days का समय लगेगा।
steps.planner_rationale: The assistant confirms the refund initiation, providing the refund ID and processing timeline as returned by the tool, without guaranteeing bank credit times.

ir.terminal_condition: Refund initiated with an id, amount and processing window.

variant_findings.reason: The assistant correctly uses Devanagari for native Hindi lexis and retains Roman script for English and domain terms (e.g., 'developer', 'pending instalment', 'refund initiate') throughout the conversation.
variant_findings.label: Language Proficiency > Language-Script Fidelity > SCRIPT_FIDELITY

variant_findings.reason: The assistant grounds the figures (amounts, deduction, refund ID, processing days) correctly based on the tool outputs. However, it fails the negative constraint by making an unsupported forward guarantee about the money being credited to the account.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e15, the assistant states 'यह amount 14 processing days में आपके account में credit हो जाएगा' (This amount will be credited to your account in 14 processing days). The tool only provides a 'processing_days' timeframe for the refund to be processed, not a guarantee of when the funds will clear and be credited by the bank. This violates the Tool Output Grounding requirement of 'no guarantee about what happens after the call ends'.
issues.repair_instruction: Rephrase the final sentence to state that the refund processing time is 14 days, without guaranteeing that the amount will be credited to the account within that exact timeframe.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates the persona, workflow, and language-script fidelity. However, the assistant makes an unauthorized forward guarantee at the end of the call by promising that the refund will be credited to the user's account in exactly 14 days, which violates the Tool Output Grounding constraints.

variant_findings.label: Language Proficiency > Language-Script Fidelity > SCRIPT_FIDELITY
